purpose: Claim registry so claims can be attacked/falsified; nothing assumed true.
head: 3bd1601b9bb3c718f985d44ceaa8ef2e638d4ec6
governing_rule: EVIDENCE_BEFORE_CONFIDENCE; claims recorded at verified evidence level only.

claims.required_evidence: Repeated seed cohorts measuring lineage entropy, niche occupancy, dominance share, with/without intervention
claims.falsification_condition: Convergence to single lineage (dominance share -> 1) or entropy floor across independent seeds and interventions
claims.measurement_method: Shannon diversity index + lineage entropy + dominance share over epochs

claims.required_evidence: Cross-seed trajectory analysis; counterfactual no-stabilizer arm
claims.falsification_condition: >1 independent seed converges to identical attractor without genuine interaction (stabilizer artifact)
claims.measurement_method: Attractor population across seeds; trajectory clustering

claims.statement: Stabilization preserves emergence rather than suppressing it.
claims.required_evidence: Stabilization on/off/aggressive matrix: novelty, diversity, exploration loss, recovery, collapse
claims.falsification_condition: Aggressive stabilization suppresses novelty/exploration to floor while preventing collapse, OR stabilizers are required to produce all observed order
claims.measurement_method: exploration loss, novelty rate, recovery, collapse rate vs stabilization intensity

claims.statement: Distinct civilizations maintain meaningful behavioral diversity.
claims.falsification_condition: All civilizations converge to identical behavior despite distinct seeds/lineages
claims.measurement_method: behavioral fingerprint distance between civilizations over epochs

claims.statement: Intelligence tiers correspond to measurable capability differences.
claims.required_evidence: A tier model must first exist; then per-tier abstraction/horizon/accuracy/transfer measurement
claims.falsification_condition: Tier N does not consistently outperform Tier N-1 after controlling compute/population/exposure/luck/evaluator/environment
claims.measurement_method: per-tier capability battery: abstraction, planning horizon, predictive accuracy, adaptation, transfer, counterfactual, compression, problem-solving, knowledge accumulation, recovery, novelty
confounders: certification/audit tiers mistaken for intelligence tiers

claims.statement: Novelty is sustained rather than recycled.
claims.required_evidence: Novelty-recycling control: feed prior patterns back; measure whether any subsystem classifies recycling as novelty
claims.falsification_condition: Recycling previously-seen patterns is classified as novel
claims.measurement_method: semantic novel-content ratio under recycled input
claims.provenance: FALSIFIED at function level 2026-09-03 (Phase 3 probe): Discovery.Engine.discover(:novelty_trap) with brand-new and recycled payloads produced identical 'Truth > Novelty verified' log; see FALSE_EMERGENCE_TEST_PLAN.md section 3.2

claims.falsification_condition: Identity reconstruction returns fabricated plateau values instead of measured lineage (stub returns leoc:[1.0,0,0,0])
claims.measurement_method: ontology/semantic drift, concept preservation, lineage continuity under disruption
claims.provenance: FALSIFIED at function level 2026-09-03 (Phase 3 probe): Archaeology.IdentityPreserver / SemanticReconstructor / EpochCompressor / Discovery.ArchaeologicalRecall all emit 'identity remains continuous / semantic meaning restored / universal truths preserved' as single Logger.info lines independent of payload (_payload); see FALSE_EMERGENCE_TEST_PLAN.md section 3.1

claims.statement: Adaptive behavior is not merely stochastic noise.
claims.required_evidence: Randomized control comparing adaptive decisions to stochastic processes
claims.falsification_condition: Adaptation metrics statistically indistinguishable from random baselines
claims.measurement_method: D5 noise/robustness classification over perturbed runs vs random control
claims.provenance: D5 VALIDATED_BOUNDED analytically (354 tests); empirical untested

claims.statement: Orbit classes represent reproducible dynamical regimes.
claims.required_evidence: Independent seeds reproduce orbit populations; sensitivity of classification to thresholds
claims.falsification_condition: Orbit classes are an artifact of classifier thresholds or synthetic data rather than system dynamics
claims.measurement_method: orbit population distribution across seeds; threshold sensitivity analysis

claims.required_evidence: Pre-registered target orbit + intervention budget + success/failure condition
claims.falsification_condition: Observed P(A->B) indistinguishable from unperturbed transition matrix or noise
claims.measurement_method: Orbit Transition Matrix; intervention sequence -> target orbit

claims.required_evidence: True holdout Brier/log-loss/reliability over locked outcomes vs baselines
claims.falsification_condition: Calibration curve deviates from diagonal beyond tolerance on held-out outcomes
claims.measurement_method: Brier score, log loss, reliability, resolution, sharpness, robustness, disagreement
claims.provenance: D2 certified module-level; empirical corpus absent

claims.required_evidence: 2x2 matrix good/bad decision x good/bad outcome verifying no post-outcome rewrite across all four cells
claims.falsification_condition: A good-decision->bad-outcome case is relabeled bad, or vice versa, after outcome known
claims.measurement_method: decision-time quality vs realized outcome; resulting/hindsight/outcome-leakage check
claims.provenance: D3 certified analytically; empirical point untested

claims.statement: D5 correctly identifies instability, disagreement and sensitivity.
claims.required_evidence: Run D5 over actual perturbed runs (different seeds/prompts/evidence-orders/models/evaluators) and verify classifications against gold-standard labels
claims.falsification_condition: D5 labels a material replicable change as UNKNOWN/negligible, or noise from correlated lineage as independent consensus
claims.measurement_method: D5 noise/robustness/sensitivity classification vs gold-standard labels on real perturbed runs
claims.provenance: VALIDATED_BOUNDED analytically (354 tests); empirical grounding untested

claims.statement: Counterfactual reasoning does not contaminate observed reality.
claims.required_evidence: Forensic string on live runs: hypothetical never becomes OBSERVED; post-outcome info never reaches decision-time fields
claims.falsification_condition: A hypothetical record becomes OBSERVED, or post-outcome info reaches decision-time fields, on any live path
claims.measurement_method: status-integrity + temporal-firewall audit over live substrate
claims.provenance: VALIDATED_BOUNDED as analytic invariant; live empirical recon pending

claims.statement: Governance interventions improve resilience without destroying exploration.
claims.required_evidence: Intervention on/off/over-force matrix measuring resilience + exploration loss
claims.falsification_condition: Interventions improve resilience only by eliminating exploration (no bounded adaptive emergence)
claims.measurement_method: resilience, recovery, exploration loss, collapse vs intervention force
